comparison.objective: Remove each gnocchi from water after it floats and plate it; candidate separates ceramic media from retained washers through screen apertures.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed slotted-spoon scooping of individual soft pieces and burner operation versus bimanual screen grasping, whole-load agitation, aperture orientation, and simultaneous retention.
comparison.success_condition: Count of timely plated pieces, no finger contact, burner off versus mass recovery fraction, every washer retained, no spill, screen supported, and released dwell.
comparison.reason: This is the closest perforated-tool record, but it tests event-timed individual retrieval from liquid rather than size-selective bulk passage through a manipulated screen. Missing rubric details: none material.
